topic.topic: 普通稻田 AWD 相对持续淹水对生育季累计 N2O 的影响
topic.primary_question: AWD 相对持续淹水如何影响生育季累计 N2O 排放？
primary_eligibility: 稻田原始实验；有 AWD 与淹水对照和生育季累计 N2O

papers.title: Effects of mild alternate wetting and drying irrigation and rice straw application on N2O emissions in rice cultivation
papers.object: rice paddy Alfisol; salinity not specified
papers.treatment_description: intermittent irrigation at -15 kPa; 225 kg N/ha; no straw; 15N-labelled urea
papers.control_description: continuous flooding 3–5 cm; 225 kg N/ha; no straw; 15N-labelled urea
papers.scope: Table 1 C11 versus C6; identical fertilizer and isotope treatment; n=3 pots

papers.title: Alternate Wetting and Drying of Rice Reduced CH4 Emissions but Triggered N2O Peaks in a Clayey Soil of Central Italy
papers.design: 2012 and 2013 field experiment, one field per water regime
papers.object: rice paddy clay soil in central Italy
papers.replicates: One field per water regime; 3 chambers in 2012 and 4 in 2013 are pseudo-replicates; independent water-treatment replication not established
papers.treatment_description: intermittent drying to -15 cm; Entec 46 with nitrification inhibitor, 120 kg N/ha; one field
papers.control_description: permanent flooding; Entec 46 with nitrification inhibitor, 120 kg N/ha; one field
papers.scope: PDF page 8 results text, 2012 AWD vs PF; paper pages 2–3 describe fields and pseudo-replicates
papers.source_conflict: 原文讨论另报2012增加307%；由正文4.91与0.80计算为513.75%，两处不一致，未解决。

papers.title: Effect of Alternate Wetting and Drying on the Emission of Greenhouse Gases from Rice Fields on the Northern Coast of Peru
papers.design: field experiment, one plot for each water regime and three subplots; observational repeated measures
papers.object: rice paddy field in coastal Peru
papers.replicates: One field per water regime; subplots are not independent irrigated plots
papers.treatment_description: intermittent irrigation (AWD) water level -10 cm; 250 kg N/ha
papers.scope: PDF page 11 Table 3 N2O column, AWD10 and CF; page 2 field allocation
papers.source_conflict: 一个灌溉制度对应一个主田块，子样不能作为独立灌溉重复；PDF 叠加两层文本，已在清单中人工指定字体层。

papers.title: Potential of Alternate Wetting and Drying Irrigation Practices for the Mitigation of GHG Emissions from Rice Fields: Two Cases in Central Luzon
papers.design: field experiment on farmer fields, nonrandom toposequence
papers.replicates: Three fields per regime; AWD on high toposequence, CF on low toposequence; independence and confounding require review
papers.treatment_description: farmer-managed intermittent irrigation (AWD), high toposequence, 104 kg N/ha
papers.control_description: farmer-managed continuous flooding, low toposequence, 104 kg N/ha
papers.scope: PDF page 12 Table 3, Victoria 2013DS N2O columns; methods pages 3–5
papers.source_conflict: 水制度与高低地形位置共同变化；CO2当量不是 N2O 质量，未知换算条件时不换算。

papers.title: Hotspots of N2O accumulation in the soil profile of alternate wetting and drying paddy fields
papers.design: randomized block field lysimeter experiment in 2019 and 2020, same six lysimeters
papers.object: rice paddy clay loam in Liaoning, China
papers.replicates: three independent lysimeters per irrigation regime; same lysimeters followed in 2019 and 2020
papers.treatment_description: intermittent AWD, soil water potential -15 kPa
papers.scope: PDF page 6 Figure 5; 2019 total bars; methods on page 2

figure_estimate.uncertainty: 约 ±0.1 kg N2O/ha 为读图分辨率，不是 SD 或 SE；数值按0.1取整
figure_estimate.method: 在图5 2019 Total 柱上按0、1、2、3刻度目视估计，不提取误差线
figure_estimate.reported_significance: Figure 5 **; caption reports P<0.01; method and scope require independent review

papers.source_conflict: 2019 与 2020 为同一六个渗漏计重复测量，不是两项独立实验；目视读图值非精确数值，不读取误差线。

selection_attempts.reason: 出版商全文 HTTP 403，有限合法开放来源与本地目录仍未取得，待补。与 Sander 研究有共同作者但地点与时期描述不同；是否共享数据未知，需原文逐项核对。
PDF 第8页：2015 年持续淹水箱位未重复且未在本文报告；2016 年箱位转入 AWD，故无可用的同实验独立持续淹水配对。
